note: Rocketlist's own Skill, published by GetEdge. It is not derived from a private internal skill and is not a port of any upstream code. Every URL pattern, query parameter, filter taxonomy, field name and parsing gotcha recorded in the bundle was checked against the live public rocketlist.ai site on 2026-09-15 without an account, without a credential, and without touching any /api/ route, which rocketlist.ai/robots.txt disallows, so the Skill uses only the surface any agent can reach. The counters quoted in the bundle (about 98,800 active jobs, about 4,860 companies) are the figures rocketlist.ai displayed on that date. The public MCP connector documented at rocketlist.ai/docs/mcp returned HTTP 502 from two separate networks during verification and is therefore written into the skill as an optional fast path with a mandatory fallback, never as a dependency.
